story:
Why this one matters: Thursday printed Bills 41-31. Sunday Night is still a time. ESPN's 20 September board has the 1 p.m. ET window in the first quarter and this game still listed at 8:20 p.m. ET.

CBS and FOX print the slate. NFL.com lists Colts at Chiefs as Sunday Night Football. ABC lists Giants at Rams on Monday.

Do not print a Sunday final. Do not print a Mahomes line. Bills 41-31 is the locked Week 2 result.
